# GraphicsDepth <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
GraphicsDepth:Int32
```

**Returns:** The depth in bits.

## Description

The color depth of the graphics mode in bits.

## Differences

* It is the depth of the buffers that [Graphics](Graphics) or [Graphics3D](Graphics3D) made: 8, 12, 15, 16, 24, 30, 32 or 64, and 32 if the depth that was asked for is none of these. See [Color depth](Graphics#color-depth).
